title: Decide whether an asynchronous response is current
statement: A UI receives responses that may complete out of order. For each response, decide whether its generation matches the latest user intent. Print ACCEPT only for a matching generation, otherwise DROP. This isolates a state-commit rule; it does not model a particular framework.

contract.stdin: First line: integer n (0 <= n <= 100000). Then n lines, each containing current_generation response_generation, both signed 64-bit integers.
contract.stdout: For each pair, print ACCEPT if equal, otherwise DROP, one per line.
contract.complexity_expectation: O(n) time, O(1) extra space apart from input/output buffering.
contract.build: Fixed runner image and compiler command; user commands are not accepted.
